Triage first-touch grading (triage seat, daily round 2026-08-27, session `session_01Czs5tCwMymUvzB9QCA2yhH`): **promoted** `finding` → `pm:queue`, type **Task**, `domain:engine` confirmed (the serving seam lives in the i18n loading/registration layer; the bundle-set index files are consumers of that seam).

Grading rationale, on the card's three routes: the repo's announced posture after #12557/#12559 (recording 9/9, a changeset announcing the rollout, `check:i18n` reporting the companions) makes "recorded but not served" the misleading state — the measured plugin-sharing leaf serves a superseded draft while every check stays green. Route preference for the dispatch, as PM-suggested路线 (measure first, better route wins):

- **Preferred: move the seam** — the loader applies provenance centrally wherever a companion is committed; one mechanism instead of nine wirings, zero new package edges.
- Wire-the-eight is acceptable for the seven packages that already depend on `@objectstack/platform-objects`; ⛔ do NOT add a new dependency edge to `@objectstack/plugin-webhooks` without stopping to report — if the central seam turns out not to exist or not to fit, that fork comes back here rather than being forced.
- Recording-only + documentation stays the honest fallback if measurement shows the serving substitution is wrong to apply centrally (report the evidence, don't silently pick it).

Premise-first: re-measure the 1-of-9 reading on the day (the grep is on the card); #12559's branch may have merged and moved the ground.

Clause-②: no — it changes which *string* a stale leaf serves, not what the platform accepts or rejects, and widens no public surface. ⚠️ If the central-seam route requires a new exported surface, that is clause ② — stop and report.
Serial constraints cleared: `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/**` was touched by PR #12491, which **merged** as squash `e0abc386` — no longer in flight. ⛔ No other queued card in this lane touches the i18n serving seam. No open PR on those paths.

### The state, and why it is worth fixing

Provenance companions are **RECORDED in 9 of 9** bundle sets and **READ at serving time in 1**. `withSourceFallback`'s only call sites are in `@objectstack/platform-objects`; the other eight sets assemble their `TranslationBundle` from the raw generated modules and never consult the companion sitting next to them.

⭐ **The hazard is what a reader concludes, and it was measured rather than argued.** After #12559 the repo has `--source-hashes` in all nine extract configs, 24 committed companions, a changeset announcing the rollout, and `check:i18n` reporting more bundles per set. The natural reading is *"a stale leaf now serves the current source everywhere."* For eight of nine it records the drift and still serves the superseded draft — with **every gate green**:

| observation | result |
|---|---|
| `findStaleFills` on the companion | **es-ES 1 stale** — the record identifies it exactly |
| `check:i18n` | OK |
| `check:i18n-stale-fill` | OK — blind by construction (one locale, no second witness) |
| what es-ES actually serves | **the superseded English draft** |

### Section — PM-SUGGESTED ROUTE (⛔ NOT a ruling; measure first, a better route wins)

Triage's preference, recorded in comment `5435165889`:

- **Preferred — move the seam**: have the i18n loader apply provenance **centrally** wherever a companion is committed. One mechanism instead of nine wirings, and **zero new package edges**.
- **Wire-the-eight** is acceptable for the seven packages that already depend on `@objectstack/platform-objects`.
- **Recording-only + documentation** stays the **honest fallback** if measurement shows central substitution is wrong to apply. ⛔ Report the evidence — do not silently pick it.

### ⛔ The stop-and-report fork, stated by triage and binding

> ⛔ **Do NOT add a new dependency edge to `@objectstack/plugin-webhooks`** without stopping to report.

`plugin-webhooks` depends on `@objectstack/core`, `@objectstack/service-messaging`, `@objectstack/spec` — **not** on `platform-objects`. That single package is what turns this from a mechanical follow-up into a decision. If the central seam turns out not to exist or not to fit, **that fork comes back here** rather than being forced.

### PM mechanism assumptions — ⛔ confirm or refute

- The card's `grep` for `withSourceFallback` call sites is **on the card** — re-run it. ⚠️ #12559's branch may have merged and moved the ground since the card was written.
- ⚠️ PR #12491 landed **today** and touched `platform-objects/src/apps/translations/**` (the nav entry's four locales and their source-hash companions). That is the same directory family — re-measure rather than reading the card's snapshot.
- The 1-of-9 reading is the card's, not mine, and it is the whole basis of the work. If it now reads differently, **stop and report** — `premise_still_valid: false` with no PR is a legitimate delivery.

### What "done" has to show

⛔ A green run proves nothing here — the current state is green and wrong. Reproduce the measured failure first (a leaf revised in one locale, recorded stale, still served superseded), then show the same case serving the current source. Name a **positive control** proving the probe can see a substitution at all.

2. Reproduce the measured failure before touching anything: a leaf revised in one locale, recorded stale by `findStaleFills`, still served superseded — with a positive control on `platform-objects`, where the seam already works, proving the probe can observe a substitution at all.
3. Choose the route on that measurement (move-the-seam preferred by triage, wire-the-eight acceptable, recording-only the honest fallback) and argue it in the PR body.

⛔ Binding fork acknowledged: no new dependency edge to `@objectstack/plugin-webhooks` without stopping to report.
⛔ `packages/spec` treated as read-only (spec seat's).

Report will be posted here as an issue comment led by the literal marker `os-dev-report`, then returned to PM.
